title: HIIT for Inflammatory Rheumatic Disease: Man vs Machine
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare two modes of delivering high-intensity interval training (HIIT) in a population with inflammatory rheumatic disease over 10 weeks. One group will recieved HIIT supervised by a healthcare professional, the other group will perform self-monitored HITT with guidance by a smarthpone application.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- Inflammatory rheumatic disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to complete the testing procedures
* Pregancy
* Not able to perform exercise intervention
* Planed surgeries or other plans during initial exercise intervention period than directly will effect the testing or training.
* Access to a smartphone
* Less than 80% compliance of planned training sessions
